subject.title: Redesign usage share card around model activity

question: Should the existing share-card default be redesigned around model activity and explicit partial-coverage disclosure, rather than its current subscription-oriented narrative?
rationale: Both presentations are intentional product choices; source review and proof can establish correctness, but cannot decide which default artifact best represents CodexBar’s sharing experience.

options.title: Approve the model-activity default
options.body: Accept this PR’s privacy-safe model-route and partial-coverage narrative as the default share-card experience after normal exact-head merge gates pass.

options.title: Keep the existing narrative
options.body: Retain the current subscription-oriented card and close or narrow this proposal to a separately approved optional presentation.

recommendation.title: Approve the model-activity default
recommendation.body: Accept this PR’s privacy-safe model-route and partial-coverage narrative as the default share-card experience after normal exact-head merge gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner has already provided the product comparison and authored adjacent contract decisions.
